title: Chapter 59 The Prophet Is Not Lu Xue
content:
Chapter 59 The Prophet Is Not Lu Xue

At this time, the Phoenix Clan ancestor quietly poked Yan Fengtian with his arm and signaled with his eyes.

Seeing this, Yan Fengtian nodded, then looked up at Lu Daosheng and said: "Well, son-in-law, we came from far away, you can't let us just stand here."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng raised his eyebrows.

This guy really dared to call him son-in-law.

He knew what his wife Yan Lingyun had experienced in the Phoenix Clan. She was simply despised by everyone. Even though Yan Lingyun was Yan Fengtian's daughter, Yan Fengtian was a little disgusted with Yan Lingyun and often doubted whether she was his own daughter.

So much so that Yan Lingyun was thrown into the small world later, and Yan Fengtian did not stop it too much.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at Yan Fengtian like this. He wanted to see why the other party was so thick-skinned.

After a moment, Yan Fengtian lowered his head in embarrassment.

Being stared at by such a terrifying strong man, the psychological pressure was really too great.

He was only at the eighth level of the Earth Realm, how could he dare to compete with Lu Daosheng, who was more terrifying than his own ancestor.

Seeing that he could not get any benefit from Lu Daosheng, Yan Fengtian suddenly had an idea and asked, "By the way, where is Xiaoxue? The last time she came to the Phoenix Clan, I didn't treat her well because I was in seclusion. This time I have to take a good look at her."

Obviously, he set his sights on Lu Xue again.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng snorted coldly, pointed directly at Yan Fengtian's nose and said coldly, "Do you think you are worthy of being a father?"

In an instant, the hall was completely quiet.

The demon elder Han Cheng on the side regretted it at this moment.

Regret why he didn't bring some melon seeds.

Coming to see the Lord of the Desolate City can actually encounter such a good show. I didn't expect that the Lord of the Desolate City, a mysterious and powerful human force, actually has such a relationship with the Phoenix Clan.

It's really exciting.

At this time, Yan Fengtian was not angry when Lu Daosheng pointed at his nose and scolded him. Instead, he lowered his head, and there was a hint of guilt in his eyes.

This detail was immediately noticed by Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng frowned, "Do you have anything else to say?"

Hearing this, Yan Fengtian waved his hand and said, "No, no."

However, the next moment, a terrifying pressure crushed Yan Fengtian.

"Speak!"

In just a moment, Yan Fengtian fell to the ground, and the terrifying pressure made his bones creak.

"Ah! Ancestor, Ancestor, save me!"

At this time, the old man of the Phoenix clan on the side was sweating.

Save you, I can save myself.

He was also in a state of turmoil at the moment.

He seriously underestimated the strength of the Lord of the Desolate City.

The other party is definitely not only in the Heavenly King Realm, but also not in the Heavenly Monarch Realm.

Could it be?

Impossible, impossible.

The Phoenix Clan ancestor shook his head repeatedly. He didn't even dare to think about that possibility.

That was already a legendary existence.

But obviously, he still had a narrow vision.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at Yan Fengtian with an extremely cold gaze.

At this time, Yan Fengtian couldn't hold on any longer, and finally said, "Stop, I'll tell you, I'll tell you!"

Suddenly, the pressure dissipated, and Lu Daosheng stared coldly at Yan Fengtian below.

Seeing this, Yan Fengtian took a breath, looked at Lu Daosheng with fear, and then slowly said, "Some time ago, Lingyun came to see me."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was shocked.

At this time, Yan Fengtian continued, "At that time, she came to me just for one thing, for, for, for, "

"Hurry up and tell me!"

Lu Daosheng said coldly.

Yan Fengtian sighed, and said with despair, "To sever the father-daughter relationship with me."

After that, Yan Fengtian was a little lifeless.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng frowned, "Anything else?"

Yan Fengtian recalled and said, "I feel that she has changed a lot. At that time, I couldn't even see through her, and she gave me an extremely strange feeling, as if she had become a different person."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was silent.

Could his wife be the reincarnation of a strong man?

The more Lu Daosheng thought about it, the more he felt it was possible.

Yan Fengtian kept sighing. It was embarrassing to be cut off by his daughter. Now, the Lord of the Deserted City knew about this, and the other party might not care about him anymore.

Of course, in fact, Lu Daosheng would not care about him whether he said it or not.

Sure enough, Lu Daosheng just glanced at Yan Fengtian and the Phoenix Clan Patriarch coldly, and then said, "Send the guests out."

The next moment, several guards with powerful auras appeared beside the two.

"Please, both of you."

Seeing this, the Phoenix Clan Patriarch looked unhappy.

But in the end, he still took Yan Fengtian away from the Deserted City.

Although they were unable to establish any friendly relations with the Desolate City, at least, they would not be hostile.

As for the gifts brought by the Phoenix Clan's ancestors, Lu Daosheng did not even take a look at them.

In his opinion, they were just a pile of garbage.

Then, some leaders of various races came to the Desolate City to find out.

There is no doubt that these forces were shocked by the strength of the human forces in the Desolate City.

Especially the Lord of the Desolate City, whose strength is even more unfathomable.

In an instant, the status of the human race in the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm suddenly rose.

The treatment of some human races who were still stranded in the outside world also gradually improved a lot.

.........

Dragon Territory.

This is the territory of the Dragon Clan, one of the several powerful races in the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

"I'm Ao Qing, I'm back!"

As soon as he returned to the dragon clan, Ao Qing shouted loudly.

Suddenly, the entire dragon clan was shaken.

In the depths of the dragon clan, a huge ice dragon suddenly opened his eyes.

"My son is back!"

With a roar.

It soared directly into the sky.

At the same time, countless dragons came in the direction of Ao Qing.

Seeing Ao Qing, the dragons excitedly said: "Lord Longzi, you are back!"

That's right, Ao Qing has a noble status in the dragon clan. He is Longzi, the future leader of the dragon clan.

Ao Qing was demoted to the Hongmeng Universe because Ao Qing accidentally damaged the treasure of the dragon clan, and secondly, it was to train Ao Qing.

The most important thing is that the powerful people in the clan predicted that Ao Qing would meet an existence that could change the fate of the entire dragon clan in a small world.

And that existence is a person with the blood of the ice phoenix.

It's just that the powerful person who predicted missed one person.

Lu Daosheng.

It was because of Lu Daosheng that changed everything.

Because the person Ao Qing should have met back then was not Lu Xue, but Yan Lingyun.

But later Lu Daosheng suddenly appeared, and fell in love with Yan Lingyun and had a child, so Yan Lingyun was unable to awaken the ice phoenix blood in her body.

Fortunately, Lu Xue also had ice phoenix blood, and successfully awakened with the help of Lu Daosheng.

It can only be said that fate is a trick.

Ao Qing's choice also brought about a huge change in the future of the dragon clan.

At this moment, a rough voice sounded.

"A Qing!"

Seeing the huge ice dragon, Ao Qing was also a little excited.

"Dad!"

At this time, the ice dragon looked at Ao Qing and was suddenly stunned, and then ecstatic.

Because at this moment he suddenly discovered that Ao Qing's cultivation had reached the ninth level of the earth realm, and what was even more terrifying was that he could clearly feel that the blood in Ao Qing's body had become extremely powerful.

This was a great opportunity.

Suddenly, he was extremely glad that he had thrown Ao Qing into that small world.

"Chief!"

When the dragons saw Ao Lie, they all said respectfully.

Ao Lie, Ao Qing's father, is the current chief of the dragon clan.

Hearing the dragon clan members calling his father the chief, Ao Qing was surprised and happy.

"Dad, you are the chief?!"

Hearing this, Ao Lie smiled and said, "Not long ago, I just became the chief."

The previous chief of the dragon clan failed to break through the heavenly realm, and eventually became possessed and suppressed by the dragon clan.

The dragon clan was also somewhat injured because of this.

Finally, Ao Lie took the position, and only then did he stabilize the dragon clan.

At this time, a giant dragon with a strong breath suddenly said, "Lord Longzi, I wonder if you met the prophet this time in the lower world?"
